messages.精神力を40以上にして「不安定E.G.O::蜜蝋の翼」に変身し、広域化するS2「: Reach at least 40 SP to transform into Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion, then apply heavy Burn with the area-enhanced S2 Sunset Blade and Blazing Strike. Deploying him alongside Dawn Office Fixer Faust and Dawn Office Rep Gregor is close to essential.
messages.変身(「不安定な自我の殻」): ターン開始時に精神力が40以上なら精神力を20消: **Transformation (Unstable Shell of Ego)**: If his SP is 40 or more at Turn Start, he spends 20 SP to transform. While transformed, he gains Volatile Passion, inflicts 1 Burn on hit, and gains +1 Final Power if the main target has Burn. At Turn End, he loses (turns transformed×5) SP, up to 40, and the transformation ends if his SP is 0 or below at Turn Start.
messages.初動はS3「烙印」: マッチ勝利時に精神力10回復、マッチ敗北時に10減少。Ⅰ・: **Open with S3 Stigmatize**: Restores 10 SP on Clash Win and loses 10 on Clash Lose. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 3 Burn each. Throw it at opponents it can beat to raise SP.
messages.変身後のS2: 使用時と攻撃後に精神力が5ずつ減る代わりに攻撃加重値+1、精神力: **S2 after transforming**: On use and after the attack, he loses 5 SP each, but gains +1 Attack Weight, and +1 more at 45 SP. Each Coin increases Burn Count by 1.
messages.「燃えたぎる一撃」: 変身中にS3が変化する1コイン技。敵全体の火傷威力合計4ご: **Blazing Strike**: A 1-Coin technique that S3 turns into while transformed. Coin Power rises per 4 total Burn Potency across all enemies (with a cap). +5/10% damage per Wrath Resonance (up to 30/60%), with more if the highest Wrath Absolute Resonance is 4 or more. Inflicts 10 Burn. Restores 10 SP on Clash Win, loses 30 on Clash Lose, and loses 15 after the attack.
messages.バトルパッシブ「スティグマ工房武器/激情」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得):: **Combat passive — Stigma Workshop Weaponry / Passion (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 to the Burn Potency and Count inflicted (up to 6 times per turn). While transformed, Coin Power increases by (SP ÷ 20), or +3 at 45 SP.
messages.夜明事務所編成: グレゴールは精神力の回復・維持と耐久を、ファウストは火力を大き: **Dawn Office team**: Gregor greatly supports his SP recovery, upkeep, and durability, and Faust greatly supports his damage (see the other Identities' data for the buff details).
messages.夜明事務所の2人と出撃する。序盤はS3「烙印」などでマッチに勝って精神力を40ま: Deploy him with the other two Dawn Office members. Early on, win Clashes with S3 Stigmatize and similar to raise his SP to 40 and transform. With both Dawn Office members present (SP recovers every turn through Gregor's Dawn Office Rep's From Dawnbreak to Sunset and the Dawn Office 3-member effect), a Clash Win with S3 or a 3-Coin skill on turn 1 lets him transform on turn 2. He can hardly gather 5 Wrath on his own, so secure it with allies' Wrath skills to activate Passion. After transforming, spread Burn Count with the multi-target S2, and fire S3 with 4 or more Wrath chained. His SP keeps dropping, so make up for it with Clash Wins to keep the transformation.
